main_text.l: Vna perisset sorte passimVictima nil miserantis unda.Sed vir relictus coniuge cum pia est,Cultor supremi Numinis integer,Arca capaci clausus aluo,Cum genitis nuribusque charis.Successit istis orta parentibusTerras per omnes gens habitabilesDiffusa sol quacunque mundumLimpidus irradiat patentem.Lugenda chordis flebilibus malaFrata summi dextera iudicisQuae mittit, ut poenas nefandisCriminibus meritas rependat.Concussa motu Gallia civicoPaces quietas odit, & ociaVicina turbat, quin ruinam,Dum ruit ipsa, aliis minatur.Sic tecta tectis finitimis metusIncensa magnos protinus afferunt:Casura sic damnum propinquisArboribus meditatur arbos.Nec sola bello Gallia concidit,Sed dira cunctos cladibus horridisBellona mortales fatigat,Funeribusque cruentat orbem,Non ante seclis visa prioribus,Et morte quouis horridior famesGrassata

page.notes: The verse lines are printed as separate lines; the last word "Grassata" stands alone at the right, as a catchword-like closing word of the passage. Some letters in the scan are faint (e.g. "Victima", "Frata", "Arca") and read with some uncertainty; a few word forms may be printing variants.
